comment: Love her! She was an amazing professor. The lectures were very engaging and she makes sure to try to make the information as easy to understand as possible. Quizzes are fairly simple if you read, and as long as you actually pay attention in class and try you should get an A.

Dr. Knouse is a fascinating professor as her lectures were always detailed and summed up the readings very well. the exams weren't too bad as long as you paid attention to the lectures and looked over the textbook. I would recommend you try & get your IRL Research component of the class done somewhat early to free up time to work on the project.

TAKE DR KNOUSE! She made me realize I love psychology and she has a ton of knowledge on the subject. The class is lecture-based, but she uses a lot of real-world examples and allows for discussion. Short reading quizzes every week, 3 exams, and one final project at the end on a topic of your choosing. She also allows 2 extensions/grade drops.

Overall, great FYS! All classes were engaging and the format was innovative. Dr. Knouse did a really good job at approaching a stigmatized topic from a non-biased perspective. She always has a specific idea for each assignment that sometimes might not be conveyed clearly, so make sure you go to office hours and get a lot of feedback on your work.
While engaging in class, professor Knouse is not the most understanding when regarding grades which is disappointing for a 100 level class.  She really turned me off from psychology which is sad.

She's a Psychology professor, but I think she taught my Core class in the spring of my freshman year. That was a long time ago, so I am not 100% sure. If I am right, what I remember was that she was a nice and caring lady that wasn't an outstanding Core professor b/c that wasn't her specialty, but she was fair and she knew how to teach.

TAKE THIS FYS!!!! I had such an amazing time in Dr. Knouse's class. It was pretty easy but very engaging! I learned so much and never felt stressed about class. Dr. Knouse is such a sweet heart and really cares about her students. I really hope to have another opportunity to take her class.

Makes the course very interesting. Gets students to think critically about the articles assigned for class. When it comes to papers she has distinct guidelines and provides all the materials for the course to you ahead of time.

Dr. Knouse is the goat (greatest of all time for clarification). Although a new class, this is easily one of the best FYS courses available. The psychology of drugs was interesting, fairly easy & far less heavy on writing papers than others. Lots of open seminar style discussions in class, very fun!

Dr. Knouse is amazing. She is so passionate about psychology, specifically behavior analysis which is what this class was about. She is receptive to student questions and feedback and is clear in her explanations of course topics. She is also insanely nice. She's an excellent professor and knows how to lead and teach a class. I highly recommend her

Dr. Knouse is one of the three professors that team-teach psych 100. She's by far the best and the most fun to learn from. Her lectures are interesting, clear, and the powerpoints always convey the information you need. Her test wasn't too hard and she gave tons of opportunity for review and to come see her for questions.

Great teacher, so sweet! Best out of the 3. Teaches through PP and posts them online. Test was straight forward-what we discussed in class. Makes class generally interesting and fun. Come to class, pay attention and an A in her section is possible.

Professor Knouse is awesome! She was my favorite out of all three professors who taught intro this year. She didn't test on the textbook so all I had to do was focus in class, take good notes, and enjoy learning. Come to class and work hard and you'll  get the A.

Dr. Knouse is the best! Probably my favorite prof at Richmond. No class is boring and she really knows her stuff. If you keep up on the reading and pay attention it's not difficult to do well. The labs were kind of tough, but shes very willing to help you out. I highly recommend you take a class with her.
Best professor I've had at UR, very enthusiastic and helpful, not to mention knowledgeable and friendly. Would definitely recommend her classes to any psych major or minor.
She explains concepts incredibly clearly, but really likes her topic, clinical. Her grading is a bit tough, had to study quite a bit for her tests. Very sweet though, always shows video of her kid.
She is a tough grader. I never knew exactly what she expected from me on her test. She is nice and explains concepts clearly but she wants very in-depth answers from you.
Laura Knouse is da bomb. She's also hilarious.  I bet wherever she used to work before really misses her.
Laura Knouse is the best there is!
